prompt: CSS text-3 Chinese writing system assumed ISO script codes
answer:
CSS Text Level 3 requires user agents to assume the writing system is **Chinese** when the writing system is unspecified for Chinese content, or when any content language uses one of these ISO 15924 script codes:

- `Hant`
- `Hans`
- `Hani`
- `Hanb`
- `Bopo`

Source: [CSS Text Module Level 3](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-text-3/)
